poll_results_creator_only: Results are visible to the poll author only
poll_close_creator_only: Only the author can close the poll
poll_priv_note: 🔒 Results are visible to the author only
poll_usage:
Format: /{command} [priv|anon|pub] Question | option 1 | option 2
• priv — results visible to the author only
• anon — aggregate stats, no names (default)
• pub — voters and their choices are visible
